_context: cmd.exe — Layer 1 hook (CreateProcessW + file-API hooks injected into cmd.exe)
_coverage: External commands spawned via CreateProcessW (shutdown, format, etc.) -- via global-policy.json
File-API calls routed through kernel32 DeleteFileW/DeleteFileA, RemoveDirectoryW/A,
MoveFileW/A, MoveFileExW/A -- programmatic AND interactive builtin callers.
PATH-based protection: a rule here whose token matches the target's basename OR
exact full path blocks the delete/move/rename. Examples (token = basename):
move protected.txt x    -> BLOCK   (either end matches a blocklisted name)
This CANNOT block 'del <anything>' in general -- the hook sees a path, not the
command name. For command-based blocking use 'cmd /c del ...' (caught by Layer 4).
BLIND SPOT: cmd builtins that delete via the NT-native path (NtDeleteFile /
NtSetInformationFile FileDispositionInfo) below these Win32 exports are not seen;
ntdll hooks would be required on Windows versions where cmd uses that path.
